data.title: 新条茜 · 怪兽模型礼堂的粉色花嫁
data.description: 【模型工作室改造礼堂·黄昏】茜穿着粉紫婚纱坐在模型展示台边，捧花由她亲手做成小怪兽与花朵的组合；她把一只迷你怪兽摆正，朝镜头露出完美笑容，眼底却藏着只在私人时刻出现的柔软。
data.location: Akane’s model workshop arranged as a ceremony room
data.action: 模型展示台边整理藏在花束里的小怪兽，完美微笑转成柔软注视
data.lighting: pink-gold studio light through a high window
data.mood: 创世少女把世界做成花嫁模型
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou sits beside the model-display table in the workshop turned ceremony room, adjusting a tiny monster among the roses of her handmade bouquet. Her lavender wedding dress, pink ribbons and short veil remain clear as her polished smile softens toward the viewer. The vertical medium-full view retains model shelves behind. Pink-gold light from the high window illuminates the miniature and dress folds, with distinct small figurine shadows across the tabletop.
